files.summary: SiteDocument is a data object representing a document associated with a site, primarily identified by ID and SiteID. It exists as a sealed class within HSPnet.DataLayer.
files.purpose: To model and track documents related to specific sites within the HSPnet application.
content_gaps: No information on document retrieval, storage, or allowed operations.

files.summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page and user control for staff administrators, displaying welcome information, last login details, and employment application data. It provides filtering and data-binding workflows for employment applications.
files.purpose: To present staff administrators with filtered views of employment applications, status, and last login details.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering
steps: Staff admin selects site, discipline/subdiscipline, start/end dates, and withdrawn status.
GridView displays employment applications matching criteria.
Row data is bound with name, email, status, site, discipline, dates, and withdrawn info.
Admins may refresh, change filters, and view application details.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are shown if checkbox is checked.
Employment applications filter by site, discipline, date, withdrawn status.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for StartDate and EndDate; must not be empty.
RegularExpressionValidators for StartDate and EndDate; must match date format.
calculations: Status field checks WithdrawnDate to determine display value 'Submitted' or 'Withdrawn'.
system_behavior: Auto-populates dropdowns for site and discipline.
Displays employment applications in a paged grid.
Shows errors and warnings if present.
Refreshes view on filter changes or button click.
content_gaps: No workflow for application submission or withdrawal.

files.summary: ServiceCode is a data entity representing a coded service, with fields for code, description, category, notes, sort order, and alternate language fields. Supports retrieval of lists by CourseID, TimetableID, and global listing.
files.purpose: To classify and organize coded services used within courses and timetables.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

workflows.name: ServiceCode List Retrieval
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to get all ServiceCodes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for filtered lists.
ServiceCodes are localized to alternate language as needed.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, descriptions and notes use alternate fields.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines which name/notes fields are used.
system_behavior: Procedures retrieve and localize ServiceCodes, close database readers after use.
content_gaps: No info on code creation, editing, or deletion.

files.summary: SiteProfileHistory logs actions taken on site profiles, recording action date, section, user, agency info, and affected fields. It includes alternate language support and formats user/agency details for display.
files.purpose: To provide an audit trail of changes made to site profiles.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: ID of original user on behalf of

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: User control triggers SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Records are filled and formatted for display/audit.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, fields use alt language values.
Tooltip formatting includes agency/user and phone, with special handling for sysadmin/acting users.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted and AgencyUserDetailsFormatted are formatted based on conditions.
conditions: If acting user differs from original user and is not sysadmin, prefix support team info.
system_behavior: Records history of site profile changes.
content_gaps: No information about who can access, edit, or delete history records.
